question: Can a numerical system actively acquire unknown causal relationships from confounded observations, write reusable knowledge into connections, and cold-reuse it on unobserved joint interventions?
hypothesis: All64 hidden affine causal worlds are identified after two initial observations plus at most2 learner-chosen single-node interventions; all512 joint-intervention predictions are correct after cold restart, and full-identification rate exceeds uniform random querying by>=25 percentage points. Unknown-family counterexamples must remain a negative, not be disguised as recovered knowledge.

frozen_world.worlds: All64 choices of six unknown binary coefficients [bY,uY,xY,bZ,xZ,yZ]. Generator/evaluator only receives true coefficient mask; model receives no mask, seed, generator object or hidden answer.
frozen_world.equations: X=U naturally; Y=bY XOR(uY AND U) XOR(xY AND X); Z=bZ XOR(xZ AND X) XOR(yZ AND Y). U is public binary context. do(X=v) replaces X equation; do(Y=v) replaces Y equation. Both can be set for heldout evaluation.
frozen_world.initial_observations: U=0 and U=1, no intervention. X=U makes observational evidence insufficient to distinguish the U->Y and X->Y coefficients. Node Z's two observed parent configurations also underidentify its three coefficients.
frozen_world.action_space: Eight ordered single-node experiments: X for U0/v0,U0/v1,U1/v0,U1/v1, then Y for the same U/value order. Max2 actual queries, no repetitions; stop early only when all six coefficient-confidence bits are known. No desired program supplied.
frozen_world.test: All8 combinations U/X/Y under joint do(X),do(Y), excluded from acquisition. Score all three output bits but primary binary transfer metric is Z; abstention counts incorrect. Native prediction must use learned numerical coefficients when identified, not a target lookup.
frozen_world.prior: Causal ordering and affine XOR/AND mechanism family are preprogrammed. This is an unfamiliar parameterized world, NOT unfamiliar primitive invention, ontology discovery or prior-free knowledge. All contexts are authored public DEV, no protected independent first-use.

frozen_model.buckets: Two numerical local mechanism buckets, Y and Z. Each has8 binary viable-hypothesis connection weights,3 writable coefficient weights and3 per-coefficient known bits. Eight used-action bits plus one contradiction latch.37 resident task-specific binary scalars; no event/world-identity dictionary in the candidate.48 static coefficient-prior bits and24 action descriptor bits plus fixed simulator/control program counted separately, not free.
frozen_model.updates: Actual observed feature/outcome compatibility gates directly update viable weights. Updates to Y are disabled when Y is intervened on; Z updates from actual parents. Unanimous viable coefficient bits directly write learned coefficients and confidence. Zero candidate gradients. Uncertainty is only within this finite prior.
frozen_model.actions: For each legal query, numerical viable-weight products predict the four possible Y/Z outcome categories. Gini disagreement score=sum count*(total-count). Fixed numeric threshold winner selection picks largest score, lowest action index on ties; no Python task-conditioned argmax/search supplies a graph/action.
frozen_model.persistence: Checkpoint serializes learned weights/confidence/action-use/fault only, no observations or true rule. Exact cold predictions and coefficients must match. Extra valid Y-intervention evidence must leave learned Y bucket unchanged. Contradictory evidence latches fault and abstains, not imaginary rule recovery.

controls.symbolic: Independent exact64-world version-space control using ordinary symbolic equations and same maximum2-query information-gain policy; must reproduce candidate observations/actions/predictions. Strongest valid reference, expected tie.
controls.random: Same numerical learner with every one of56 ordered distinct two-query schedules, uniformly weighted, per world; same initial observations, max2 queries and early stopping. Report3584 cases and normalized rates, not pretend duplicates are independent worlds.
controls.no_intervention: Initial observational evidence only, plus repeated natural observations if needed; must not invent full causal identification. Report ambiguity/abstention.
controls.trained: Two8-logit softmax mixture-of-affine-experts models (16 floating scalars), genuine full-batch Adam LR.1,beta.9/.999,epsilon1e-8,max4096 updates, mean outcome NLL<=.01 per bucket. Same static mechanism family and identical actual active transcript, intervention eligibility masks. No extra labels. Convergence mandatory for128 bucket fits. Confidence threshold .95; middle probabilities abstain. Architecture/scalar/compute differences disclosed; no false matched-total-cost superiority.
controls.erasure: Clear all task evidence/learned synapses; all heldout predictions should abstain.
controls.outside_family: Choose the one (X,Y) parent pair absent from the active Z observation transcript, preserving every acquired event but flip Z there. This observationally indistinguishable nonlinear extension changes2/8 heldout joint labels per world. Affine model expected to make128 confident errors out of512; after one real joint counterexample all64 models must latch contradiction and abstain. This is a required information/prior limitation, not a failed implementation.

classification_rules.dev_supported: 64/64 identification within budget,512/512 joint Z after cold,64 cold restores and no learned Y damage; random identification improvement>=.25; exact symbolic tie and all negative controls valid
classification_rules.negative: frozen acquisition/transfer/active-value hypothesis fails with valid controls
classification_rules.invalid: leakage, hidden true rule in candidate, changed data/budgets/thresholds, invalid baseline/custody
classification_rules.scientific_pass: Unavailable: authored known-family DEV, strongest exact symbolic reference. Report TIE even if narrower active-vs-random mechanism succeeds

qualification: Remote prereg before implementation/primary. All original+WSP01-17+WSP19-24 final unit suites, full frozen evaluator, interfaces/negatives/checkpoints, permanent G29 and clean source on hosted Windows2022/Ubuntu at exact final SHA/tree. Reuse existing read-only PR workflow; no new controller, workflow, private runner, paid API, protected first-use, merge/integration/deployment.
